Questions

What did we ask?

The questions people in Algeria put to an assistant before they choose a bank, a mobile operator, an appliance or a delivery company.

needs
2languageseach need is written in French and in Arabic
questionsasked every day to each assistant
answers a daytwo assistants, every question
Typed the way people type

Lower case, no accents, everyday wording. For example “c quoi la meilleure banque en algerie”.

Chosen from real searches

Each need is one that people in Algeria search for. The monthly search volume is recorded next to every question.

Frozen before the first day

The wording does not change during the 28 days, so one day can be compared with the next.

Always about Algeria

Every question names Algeria or an Algerian city, so the assistants answer for the Algerian market.

Collection

How did we ask?

Like a visitor with no account, from Algeria, once a day.

The real websites

Each question is typed into the public website of ChatGPT and of Gemini, in a real browser. This is what a person sees, not what the developer API returns.

A clean session every time

A new browser session is opened for every question. No account, no history, no memory of the question before.

From Algeria

Both assistants are asked from Algeria: every session connects from the country, on Algerian time. ChatGPT also displays the country it detected, and the tool checks it on every answer. Gemini displays nothing to check.

Once a day for 28 days

From 22 October to 18 November 2026, at 15:17 Algerian time. A day is never collected twice.

Web search

ChatGPT is told to search the web, and an answer where the search did not run is asked again. Gemini has no such setting and decides by itself. The two assistants are therefore not run in exactly the same way.

No model is chosen

We get the model an anonymous visitor is served.

Tooling

Which tools collect the answers?

For technical readers. The collection runs by itself every day, and every answer is saved exactly as it arrived.

The scraper, DataForSEO LLM Scraper

What it does
Opens the consumer website in Chrome on Windows, types the question, and returns what the page showed.
Endpoints
POST /v3/ai_optimization/chat_gpt/llm_scraper/task_postPOST /v3/ai_optimization/gemini/llm_scraper/task_postGET …/llm_scraper/task_get/advanced/{id}
Mode
Standard queue. Tasks are posted, then fetched every 30 seconds until ready. Most are ready in 35 to 70 seconds; a few Gemini tasks waited up to 17 minutes. A task not ready after 45 minutes is fetched by the next run.
Fields returned
markdown the answer, sources the citations shown with it, search_results the pages ChatGPT's search retrieved, fan_out_queries, brand_entities, model, datetime the exact capture time in UTC.
Its own retries
A failed attempt is retried by the tool, up to about 10 times. Since the evening of 29 October a Gemini refusal is also retried once in a new session.
Cost
0.0012 USD per answer, about 0.23 USD for a day of 188.

One request

POST /v3/ai_optimization/chat_gpt/llm_scraper/task_post

[{
  "keyword": "c quoi la meilleure banque en algerie",
  "location_code": 2012,
  "language_code": "fr",
  "force_web_search": true,
  "priority": 1
}]

location_code 2012 is Algeria. force_web_search exists for ChatGPT only. priority 1 is the standard queue.

One day of collection, in UTC

  1. 14:17The roundAn outside scheduler starts a GitHub Actions job that posts the day's tasks. Two GitHub schedules stand by as backups; a rule stops a day from running twice.
  2. 16:30The retrySince day 16, every answer that is refused or cut off is posted once more, with the same settings. The first answer is never overwritten.
  3. 17:00The health checkCounts the day's files and reads every answer. A missing answer, or more than 5 unusable answers for one assistant, sends an email alert.
  4. AfterThe recordEach raw answer is saved untouched as one JSON file. Brand counts are rebuilt by script, and a dated log records every decision and incident.
Counting

How is a brand counted?

A script reads the text of each answer and notes three things.

Mentioned
The brand's name appears in the answer. Counted once per answer, however many times it is written.
Mentioned first
The brand whose name comes earliest in the text of the answer.
Cited
A website is in the list of sources the assistant shows with its answer. Counted once per answer.
brands, names

Each brand is looked for under all its names: full name, short name, Arabic spelling and the way it is said aloud.

Only the words of the answer

A brand is mentioned when its name is written in the text. A link to its website alone is not a mention; that is counted as cited. The name must stand as a word of its own, so BEA is not found inside “beaucoup”. For a bank question only banks are looked for.

Arabic handled

Accents and capitals are ignored, Arabic letter variants are aligned, and a name still matches with an Arabic prefix attached to it.

Brands added along the way

The study started with brands. more were added because the assistants kept mentioning them. They are counted over every day, like the others. Other names are kept on record and are not part of any share.

Left out

What was left out and why?

An answer that is not an answer is never counted as “no brand mentioned”. It is counted apart.

questions asked
answers usedevery figure of the platform is counted on these
refusalsall from Gemini, after the retry
answers lostall from Gemini, after the retry
Refusals

Gemini sometimes replies with one sentence saying it cannot help. On a first try this happened times, . The DataForSEO team confirmed these are real replies served to anonymous visitors. They are reported as a result and never enter a brand count.

Cut-off answers

Some Gemini answers stop in the middle of a sentence: first tries. The DataForSEO team traced it to a change in the way Google streams the answer, which made the tool keep an early fragment. These are missing data.

Read from the text

The tool reports success even for a refusal or a fragment, so every answer is classified from its text: a refusal sentence from a fixed list, fewer than 200 characters, or a Gemini answer that ends mid-sentence.

One retry the same day

From day 16, on 6 November, an unusable answer was asked once more that afternoon. were retried and recovered. Days 1 to 15 had no retry.

Rules fixed in advance

On 6 November, before any analysis, two checks were fixed: the results without the retried answers, and without the two days of mass refusals. A result that changes direction under either check is not treated as robust.

Limits

What does it not prove?

Five things to keep in mind before quoting a figure.

Not your own screen

A logged-in assistant that knows you may answer differently from a new anonymous session.

Not why

We count what the assistants say. We do not know what makes them say it.

Not all of AI

Two assistants, four sectors, French and Arabic, Algeria, one month.

Not what one try will show

A figure here is how often something happened over the days of the study. Ask the same question once and the answer may well be different.

Not a like-for-like duel

ChatGPT was told to search the web. Gemini has no such setting and decided by itself.

What this study does not tell us

  • What you would see on your own deviceWe asked from a new session, with no account and no history. An assistant that knows you may answer differently.
  • Why a brand is mentionedWe count what the assistants say. We do not claim to know what makes them say it, but the sources they cite can help SEO professionals make better-informed decisions.
  • What you would get with other settingsWe tested two assistants and four sectors over one month in Algeria. Change any of these and the results may differ.
